data.Q: Why do the Danites look for a place to live?
data.A: The Danites have not yet received a share among Israel.

data.Q: Who do the Danites tell to go examine the land?
From where are the five leading men sent?
data.wrong_answer: Into the hill country of Ephraim.

data.Q: What happens after the five men come to Micah’s house?
data.A: The five men spend the night there.
data.wrong_answer: The five men examine the land.

data.Q: For what purpose do the Danites send the five men?
data.wrong_answer: To settle in their own place.
